doc: E21'in sözleri (K110). Kimlik act0.<görev>.<anahtar>; konuşanın görünen adı speakers'ta. Sesler okununca data/vo_lines.json'a girer; bu dosya metnin kaynağıdır, act0-text.md ile aynıdır.

ebe_man.en: A man of the midwife's camp

ebe_woman.en: A woman of the midwife's camp

lines.speaker: mother
lines.tr: Kalk kızım. Saruk Ebe'nin sabası aç kaldı.
lines.en: Up, my girl. Saruk Ebe's churn has gone hungry.

lines.speaker: mother
lines.tr: İki tulum kısrak sütü. Kayın Obası'na sen götüreceksin. Dereyi yavaş geç.
lines.en: Two skins of mare's milk. You're taking them to Birch Camp. Go slowly over the stream.

lines.speaker: saruk
lines.tr: Hah, sütüm geldi. Dök bakalım sabaya.
lines.en: Ah, my milk is here. Pour it into the churn, then.

lines.speaker: saruk
lines.en: Not a single drop spilled.

lines.speaker: saruk
lines.tr: Yarısı yolda kalmış. Olsun, yine kımız olur.
lines.en: Half of it stayed on the road. Never mind. It'll still be kumis.

lines.speaker: saruk
lines.tr: Kımız bin kez çalkalanır. Sen yirmisini çalkala, gerisini ben sayarım.
lines.en: Kumis is churned a thousand times. You churn twenty. I'll count the rest.

lines.speaker: saruk
lines.en: Twenty. You've a strong arm.

lines.speaker: boru
lines.en: Girls don't make wrestlers.

lines.speaker: saruk
lines.tr: Bebek gelince toy olur. Orada görürüz.
lines.en: When the baby comes, there'll be a feast. We'll see then.

lines.speaker: mother
lines.en: Your hands smell of milk. Good.

lines.speaker: father
lines.en: A blizzard's coming. Your brother and I are going to the horses.

lines.speaker: boru
lines.tr: Ocağımız söndü! Ablam doğuruyor, ebem köz istiyor!
lines.en: Our fire's gone out! My sister's having the baby, and Grandma needs embers!

lines.speaker: mother
lines.tr: Köz kabını al. Kazıkları say: on ikincide dereye inersin.
lines.en: Take the ember pot. Count the stakes. At the twelfth, you go down to the stream.

lines.speaker: mother
lines.en: Keep Boru by your side.

lines.speaker: boru
lines.en: I can't see the stake!

lines.speaker: boru
lines.tr: Kurt mu o? Ateşin yanına gelmez, değil mi?
lines.en: Is that a wolf? It won't come near the fire, will it?

lines.speaker: saruk
lines.en: Embers! Bring them here, quick.

lines.speaker: saruk
lines.tr: Işık döndü. Şimdi çıkın, kapıda bekleyin.
lines.en: The light's back. Now out, both of you. Wait by the door.

lines.speaker: saruk
lines.en: One more.

lines.speaker: boru
lines.en: Is it a boy or a girl?

lines.speaker: saruk
lines.en: A life. The rest can wait till morning.

lines.speaker: tonga
lines.en: Who brought the fire?

lines.speaker: saruk
lines.en: The girl from Lake Camp.

lines.speaker: mother
lines.tr: Koyunlar gece açıkta doğurdu. Kuzuları bul, yurda getir. Sesinden bulursun.
lines.en: The ewes lambed out in the open last night. Find the lambs and bring them inside. Follow their voices.

lines.speaker: mother
lines.en: One.

lines.speaker: mother
lines.en: Two.

lines.speaker: mother
lines.en: Three.

lines.speaker: mother
lines.en: Four. All of them alive.

lines.speaker: mother
lines.tr: Bu donmuş. Ocağın yanına koy, ağzına ilk sütü damlat.
lines.en: This one's frozen through. Set it by the fire and drip the first milk into its mouth.

lines.speaker: bard
lines.tr: Tipi gecesi doğan iyi yaşar. Künay'ın oğlu da öyle olsun.
lines.en: What's born on a blizzard night lives well. May Kunay's son do the same.

lines.speaker: mother
lines.tr: Kayın Obası'nda şilde var. Yeni doğanın ilk gecelerinde ocak sönmez, gülüşme eksik olmaz.
lines.en: There's a watch-night at Birch Camp. In a newborn's first nights the fire never dies, and the laughing never stops.

lines.speaker: father
lines.tr: Gidelim. Işığın dışında oturan gürültüyü sevmez.
lines.en: Let's go. The one who sits outside the light can't stand noise.

lines.speaker: saruk
lines.tr: Gel kız. Bu kımız senin getirdiğin sütten. İki elinle al.
lines.en: Come here, girl. This kumis is from the milk you brought. Take it with both hands.

lines.speaker: saruk
lines.tr: Ekşi mi? İlk kımız ekşi olur.
lines.en: Sour? The first kumis always is.

lines.speaker: kunay
lines.tr: Ateşi sen getirdin. Oğlum seni bilsin.
lines.en: You brought the fire. Let my son know you.

lines.speaker: tonga
lines.tr: Küçük yay beşikte durur. Büyüyünce kendisi gerer.
lines.en: The little bow stays on the cradle. When he's grown, he'll string it himself.

lines.speaker: folk_man
lines.en: Laugh! A watch-night is never quiet.

lines.speaker: folk_woman
lines.en: Another branch on the fire!

lines.speaker: boru
lines.tr: Kızdan pehlivan olmaz dedim. Gel de göster.
lines.en: I said girls don't make wrestlers. Come and show me.

lines.speaker: tonga
lines.tr: Kuşak bırakılmaz. Sırtı yere değen yenilir.
lines.en: Nobody lets go of the belt. Whoever's back touches the ground loses.

lines.speaker: tonga
lines.en: Grip!

lines.speaker: boru
lines.en: Again!

lines.speaker: boru
lines.en: Grandma was right.

lines.speaker: saruk
lines.en: Who falls gets up. Who gets up, laughs.

lines.speaker: mother
lines.tr: Yarın ocağı sen kur. Ozan uzun söyleyecek.
lines.en: Tomorrow you build the fire. The bard means to sing a long one.

lines.speaker: bard
lines.tr: Bu gece uzun bir şey söyleyeceğim. Ateşi sen kur; tipi ocak taşlarını çatlattı.
lines.en: Tonight I'll sing something long. You build the fire. The blizzard cracked the hearthstones.

lines.speaker: father
lines.tr: Kuru dal orman kıyısında. Yaş odun yalnız duman eder.
lines.en: There's dry wood at the edge of the forest. Green wood only smokes.

lines.speaker: older_brother
lines.tr: Derede taş çok. Büyüğünü kır, üçünü getir.
lines.en: The stream's full of stones. Break a big one and bring three.

lines.speaker: bard
lines.en: Three stones. Always three.

lines.speaker: bard
lines.tr: Al. Ak taşı kara taşa vur.
lines.en: Here. Strike the white stone on the black.

lines.speaker: mother
lines.en: It's caught. Feed it.

lines.speaker: father
lines.en: The light's reached us.

lines.speaker: bard
lines.en: Now it's ready.

lines.speaker: lan_hatun
lines.tr: Kalk. Bugün sürüyü Kamışlı Göl'e üçünüz götüreceksiniz. Luhun yolu bilir.
lines.en: Up. Today the three of you are taking the flock to Reed Lake. Luhun knows the way.

lines.speaker: lan_hatun
lines.en: Be back before the sun goes down behind the hill.

lines.speaker: luhun_child
lines.tr: Göl ötede, ılgınların ardında. Ardımdan gelin.
lines.en: The lake's that way, past the tamarisks. Follow me.

lines.speaker: yanchi_child
lines.en: One's getting away! Head it off!

lines.speaker: luhun_child
lines.en: The ones on the right are scattering!

lines.speaker: yanchi_child
lines.en: The lake! The lambs can smell the water.

lines.speaker: luhun_child
lines.en: Who's swimming? Last one in is a frog!

lines.speaker: yanchi_child
lines.en: It's deep out there, come back!

lines.speaker: luhun_child
lines.tr: Sazlığın dibinde ak bir taş var. Çıkaran bey olur.
lines.en: There's a white stone at the bottom, by the reeds. Whoever brings it up is a lord.

lines.speaker: yanchi_child
lines.en: He got it! The white stone's his!

lines.speaker: luhun_child
lines.en: That cloud looks like a horse.

lines.speaker: yanchi_child
lines.en: The Tanhu's horse. A white one.

lines.speaker: mete_child
lines.en: My father's.

lines.speaker: luhun_child
lines.en: You'll see him at the count.

lines.speaker: yanchi_child
lines.en: Let's count them. Drive them between the two stones.

lines.speaker: yanchi_child
lines.en: Thirty-eight.

lines.speaker: yanchi_child
lines.en: Thirty-nine.

lines.speaker: luhun_child
lines.en: One's missing!

lines.speaker: yanchi_child
lines.en: In the reeds! It's stuck in the mud!

lines.speaker: luhun_child
lines.en: A fox! It's waiting for the lamb!

lines.speaker: luhun_child
lines.en: It ran off!

lines.speaker: mete_child
lines.en: Forty.

lines.speaker: yanchi_child
lines.en: The sun's touching the hill. Let's go back!

lines.speaker: lan_hatun
lines.en: Forty went out, forty came back.

lines.speaker: yanchi_child
lines.en: The moon's coming up! Let's play white bone!

lines.speaker: luhun_child
lines.tr: Ben atarım. Bulan direğe koşar, ötekiler yakalar.
lines.en: I'll throw it. Whoever finds it runs for the post, and the others try to catch them.

lines.speaker: luhun_child
lines.en: White bone, lie in the moonlight!

lines.speaker: yanchi_child
lines.en: He's got it! Catch him!

lines.speaker: yanchi_child
lines.en: I've got it! I've got it!

lines.speaker: luhun_child
lines.en: It's mine!

lines.speaker: luhun_child
lines.en: You got me! Take it, run!

lines.speaker: yanchi_child
lines.en: He made the post!

lines.speaker: luhun_child
lines.en: I made it!

lines.speaker: lan_hatun
lines.tr: Ay yükseldi. Yatın artık; yarın biri Hereka'ya gidecek.
lines.en: The moon's high. Bed now. Tomorrow someone is going to Hereka.

lines.speaker: lan_hatun
lines.tr: Öbür gün sayım var. Bu kurutu Hereka Ebe'ye götür, çetelesini al gel.
lines.en: The count is the day after tomorrow. Take this dried curd to Hereka, and bring back her tally stick.

lines.speaker: lan_hatun
lines.tr: Sayımı obasına da söyle. Herkes duysun.
lines.en: And tell her camp about the count. Everyone must hear.

lines.speaker: mete_child
lines.en: Hold your dog!

lines.speaker: hereka_young
lines.en: I've got him. Come. Whose boy are you?

lines.speaker: mete_child
lines.en: Lan Hatun's.

lines.speaker: hereka_young
lines.tr: Bilirim. Altı güz önce kapıda seni ben saydım.
lines.en: I know. Six autumns ago, at the door, I was the one who counted you.

lines.speaker: hereka_young
lines.tr: Al. Yedi çentik, bu yıl doğanlar. Sayıcıya ver, eksik yazmasın.
lines.en: Here. Seven notches, this year's births. Give it to the counter, so he doesn't write us short.

lines.speaker: mete_child
lines.en: The count's the day after tomorrow!

lines.speaker: ebe_woman
lines.en: We heard, we heard.

lines.speaker: ebe_man
lines.en: The horses are fat. We'll come and be counted.

lines.speaker: hereka_young
lines.en: Tell your mother her curd turned out well.

lines.speaker: lan_hatun
lines.en: Did you bring it? Seven. The counter will be pleased.

lines.speaker: counter
lines.en: Hereka's notches. Seven.

lines.speaker: mother
lines.tr: Künay'ın vakti yakın. Kımız ona güç verir; Saruk bekliyor.
lines.en: Kunay's time is near. Kumis gives her strength, and Saruk is waiting.

lines.speaker: mother
lines.tr: Saruk'a selam söyle. Künay'a da sevgimi götür.
lines.en: Give Saruk my greetings. And take my love to Kunay.

lines.speaker: folk_man
lines.tr: Sırık senden büyük, kızım. Yavaş git.
lines.en: That yoke's bigger than you, girl. Go slowly.

lines.speaker: folk_woman
lines.tr: Göl Obası'nın kızı geldi! Saruk, sütün geldi!
lines.en: The girl from Lake Camp is here! Saruk, your milk is here!

lines.speaker: kunay
lines.en: Come, catch your breath. That yoke is heavy.

lines.speaker: kunay
lines.tr: Bu sabah çok tekmeledi. Yakında, diyor Saruk.
lines.en: He kicked all morning. Soon, Saruk says.

lines.speaker: saruk
lines.tr: Bu kımız şildeye yetişir. Künay'ın gücü bununla döner.
lines.en: This will be ready in time for the watch-night. It'll bring Kunay's strength back.

lines.speaker: mother
lines.tr: Rüzgâr döndü. Bu gece tipi var.
lines.en: The wind's turned. There'll be a blizzard tonight.

lines.speaker: bard
lines.tr: Kapıyı sıkı bağla. Tipi kapının yerini bilir.
lines.en: Tie the door tight. A blizzard knows where the door is.

lines.speaker: boru
lines.tr: Ebem der ki tipide yolu yalnız kazıklar bilir.
lines.en: Grandma says in a blizzard only the stakes know the road.

lines.speaker: boru
lines.en: Six. We're halfway.

lines.speaker: boru
lines.en: My sister was crying out. I'm scared.

lines.speaker: boru
lines.tr: Sen hiç konuşmuyorsun, değil mi? Olsun.
lines.en: You never talk, do you? That's all right.

lines.speaker: boru
lines.en: Twelve! The stream's right there!

lines.speaker: boru
lines.tr: Ebem der ki doğum gecesi ışık sönerse kapıda biri bekler.
lines.en: Grandma says if the light goes out on a birth night, someone waits at the door.

lines.speaker: boru
lines.en: But the light's on now. You lit it.

lines.speaker: mother
lines.tr: Kalk, kar yağmış. Tipi gitti, kuzular geldi.
lines.en: Up. It snowed. The blizzard's gone, and the lambs have come.

lines.speaker: older_brother
lines.tr: Atlar tamam. Kır kısrak da taylamış.
lines.en: The horses are all here. And the grey mare's foaled.

lines.speaker: mother
lines.en: Pick it up. Its mother will follow.

lines.speaker: mother
lines.en: There's one more bleating, down by the stream.

lines.speaker: bard
lines.tr: Kopuzun teli de üşüdü. Akşama ısınır.
lines.en: The kopuz strings are cold too. They'll be warm by evening.

lines.speaker: mother
lines.tr: Al, bu keçe kundağı Künay'a sen ver.
lines.en: Here. You give this felt swaddle to Kunay.

lines.speaker: mother
lines.en: Nobody goes to a watch-night empty-handed.

lines.speaker: saruk
lines.tr: Önce Gök'e, sonra Yer'e, sonra ocağa.
lines.en: First to the Sky, then to the Earth, then to the hearth.

lines.speaker: kunay
lines.en: From your mother's hands? It's still warm.

lines.speaker: folk_man
lines.tr: Bu gece kimse uyumaz. Uyuyan şildeyi kaçırır.
lines.en: Nobody sleeps tonight. Whoever sleeps misses the watch-night.

lines.speaker: folk_woman
lines.tr: Hadi, bir türkü daha! Bebek dinliyor.
lines.en: Come on, another song! The baby's listening.

lines.speaker: father
lines.en: Tonga, long life to your son.

lines.speaker: tonga
lines.tr: Ateşi getiren sendin. Bu ocakta yerin var.
lines.en: You were the one who brought the fire. There's a place for you at this hearth.

lines.speaker: folk_man
lines.tr: Halka açılsın! Göl Obası'nın kızı Börü'ye karşı!
lines.en: Make a ring! The girl from Lake Camp against Boru!

lines.speaker: tonga
lines.en: Keep your weight in your feet. When he pushes, give way.

lines.speaker: tonga
lines.tr: Kazanan kartal gibi açar kollarını. Hadi.
lines.en: The winner spreads her arms like an eagle. Go on.

lines.speaker: boru
lines.en: Let's wrestle again tomorrow.

lines.speaker: mother
lines.tr: Bu gece ozanın gecesi. Herkes ateşin başında olacak.
lines.en: Tonight is the bard's night. Everyone will be at the fire.

lines.speaker: bard
lines.tr: Neden üç, biliyor musun? Bu gece anlatacağım.
lines.en: Do you know why three? I'll tell it tonight.

lines.speaker: older_brother
lines.tr: Bu kadar odunla sabaha dek yanar.
lines.en: With this much wood it'll burn till morning.

lines.speaker: mother
lines.en: Come, sit by me.

lines.speaker: yanchi_child
lines.tr: Yayını aldın mı? Gölde ördek olur.
lines.en: Did you bring your bow? There are ducks at the lake.

lines.speaker: luhun_child
lines.tr: Babam der ki Sarı Irmak eskiden buradan akarmış. Göl ondan kalmış.
lines.en: My father says the Yellow River used to run through here. The lake is what it left behind.

lines.speaker: yanchi_child
lines.en: The river left and forgot the lake.

lines.speaker: mete_child
lines.en: It didn't forget. It's waiting.

lines.speaker: luhun_child
lines.en: Cranes! They're going south.

lines.speaker: yanchi_child
lines.en: One day we'll go too.

lines.speaker: yanchi_child
lines.tr: Bak, Dailin'in dumanları. Sayıma herkes geliyor.
lines.en: Look, the smoke from the Dailin. Everyone's coming to the count.

lines.speaker: yanchi_child
lines.en: The water's freezing!

lines.speaker: luhun_child
lines.en: A fish touched my foot!

lines.speaker: mete_child
lines.en: I'll give this to my mother.

lines.speaker: yanchi_child
lines.en: Will the counter count us too?

lines.speaker: luhun_child
lines.en: He counts everyone. If he doesn't count you, you're not there.

lines.speaker: luhun_child
lines.tr: Ay doğmadan ağılda olalım. Kurt saatidir.
lines.en: Let's have them in the pen before the moon's up. It's the wolves' hour.

lines.speaker: lan_hatun
lines.tr: Ak taş… Sende kalsın. Ak taş yolu bilir.
lines.en: A white stone… You keep it. A white stone knows the way.

lines.speaker: lan_hatun
lines.tr: Uzaklaşmayın. Ay ışığı kemiği gösterir, kurdu da.
lines.en: Don't wander off. Moonlight shows the bone, and it shows the wolf too.

lines.speaker: yanchi_child
lines.en: Wait… I can't breathe…

lines.speaker: luhun_child
lines.en: You're slower than the old sheep!

lines.speaker: yanchi_child
lines.tr: Bir el daha! Bu kez ben atarım.
lines.en: Another round! I'm throwing this time.

lines.speaker: mete_child
lines.en: My father's bowing to the moon now.

lines.speaker: lan_hatun
lines.tr: Hereka yeni doğanları sayar. Çetelesi olmazsa sayıcı bizi eksik yazar.
lines.en: Hereka keeps count of the newborns. Without her stick, the counter will write us short.

lines.speaker: hereka_young
lines.tr: Gir. Otlara dokunma; her biri bir doğum için.
lines.en: Come in. Don't touch the herbs. Each one is for a birth.

lines.speaker: hereka_young
lines.tr: Doğduğun şafak dolunay batıyordu, güneş doğuyordu. Baban ikisine de eğildi.
lines.en: The dawn you were born, the full moon was setting and the sun was rising. Your father bowed to them both.

lines.speaker: ebe_man
lines.tr: Sayıcıya söyle, bizim tay da sayılsın.
lines.en: Tell the counter our foal should be counted too.

lines.speaker: lan_hatun
lines.en: What did Hereka say?

lines.speaker: mete_child
lines.en: She counted me.

lines.speaker: lan_hatun
lines.en: That's right. It was her voice at the door.

lines.speaker: yanchi_child
lines.en: I got there first! Me!

lines.speaker: mete_child
lines.en: My mother sent it. To say thank you.
